free_tier_limits: Free. The web search is intended for individual users and must not be used by automated systems configured to run continual searches; automated screening should use OFAC's downloadable machine-readable files.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: Replace "unknown." Current official FAQ 287 expressly limits the free search tool to individual use, prohibits continual automated searching, and directs automated users to downloadable list files: https://ofac.treasury.gov/faqs/287
